decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Actually inspected exact original native pixels and latest alpha comparison. Required source-specific correction: The exact source is a near-strict left-facing side portrait under a pale naval cap; the target turns toward the viewer with a prominent second green eye. Restore the original left-facing side silhouette, gaze and only actual source-visible eye. Keep the far eye hidden by the head where it is absent from the original. Preserve the pale cap, dark visor and source-visible small circular fitting, genuine hair, dark suit, white collar and dark tie. Do not invent a new cap emblem, shift the head toward the viewer or introduce a long yellow neck. Preserve unrelated source appearance, full raw resolution, actual photograph frame/note and wholly opaque photo interior. No programmatic art patch.
